# federation-entity

<!-- Generated by tools/config-reference.py from libs/openid-federation/src/main/resources/META-INF/oidf-settings/federation-entity.json. Do not edit: change the catalogue, then run python3 tools/config-reference.py. -->

The settings of the `federation-entity` component of `libs/openid-federation`, read by package `com.pingidentity.ps.oidf.federation`: generated from its catalogue, [federation-entity.json](../../libs/openid-federation/src/main/resources/META-INF/oidf-settings/federation-entity.json), by `tools/config-reference.py`, and checked in CI. [How to read a row](README.md#reading-a-row).

Families: `OIDF_FEDERATION_`. A name under one of these that no catalogue declares is an unknown key.

| Setting | Default | What it does | When it's wrong | Profile | Security |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `OIDF_FEDERATION_TRUST_ANCHORS` (init-param `trustAnchorIssuers`, then env `OIDF_FEDERATION_TRUST_ANCHORS`) | Unset; a list, space- or comma-separated | This entity's superiors, comma-separated, published as its authority_hints; with PingFederate's own issuer in the list it is an anchor instead and publishes trust_mark_issuers and trust_mark_owners | **Doesn't start**: Unset or blank: the federation servlet does not start | Any | Yes |
| `OIDF_FEDERATION_SUBORDINATES` (init-param `subordinates`, then env `OIDF_FEDERATION_SUBORDINATES`) | Unset; a list, space- or comma-separated | Entities this one vouches for, comma-separated: /federation/fetch issues a statement about each with the keys its own configuration publishes, and /federation/list lists them | **Not checked**: A bad entry fails when it is fetched | Any | Yes |
| `OIDF_FEDERATION_SIGNING_ALG` (init-param `signingAlgorithm`, then env `OIDF_FEDERATION_SIGNING_ALG`) | `RS256`; one of `RS256`, `PS256` | How this entity signs its statements, with PingFederate's current RSA key | **Doesn't start**: Anything but RS256 or PS256, exactly: the federation servlet does not start | Any | Yes |
| `OIDF_FEDERATION_ORGANIZATION_NAME` (init-param `organizationName`, then env `OIDF_FEDERATION_ORGANIZATION_NAME`) | Unset | organization_name in this entity's federation_entity metadata | **Not checked**: Published as given | Any | No |
| `OIDF_FEDERATION_CLIENT_REGISTRATION_TYPES` (init-param `clientRegistrationTypes`, then env `OIDF_FEDERATION_CLIENT_REGISTRATION_TYPES`) | `automatic,explicit`; a list, space- or comma-separated | What client_registration_types_supported advertises; federation_registration_endpoint is published only with explicit. Advertising only: registration works whatever it says | **Not checked**: Unknown values are published as given | Any | No |
| `OIDF_FEDERATION_RESOLVE_DISCOVERY` (init-param `resolveDiscovery`, then env `OIDF_FEDERATION_RESOLVE_DISCOVERY`) | `known`; one of `known`, `any` | Who the resolve endpoint answers for: known, only this entity, its subordinates and the entities it hosts (18.1); any, anyone | **Doesn't start**: Anything but known or any, in any case: the federation servlet does not start | In production only as accepted risk `resolve-any` | Yes |
| `OIDF_FEDERATION_ATTESTER_JWKS` (init-param `attesterJwks`, then env `OIDF_FEDERATION_ATTESTER_JWKS`) | Unset; a JSON object | The co-hosted attester's public keys, published as oauth_client_attester.jwks so other authorisation servers can trust its attestations through the federation | **Doesn't start**: Not a JWK Set, or a key that is not public: the federation servlet does not start | Any | Yes |
| `trustControllerHost` (init-param) | Unset | Read and kept, and nothing uses it: the trust controller is OIDF_FEDERATION_TRUST_CONTROLLER_HOST's, which is read here from the environment when this is unset | **Not checked**: Has no effect | Any | No |
| `ignoreSslErrors` (init-param) | `false` | Whether the federation servlet's own fetches (resolve, Trust Mark status) skip certificate checks, for a test federation only; unset, OIDF_FEDERATION_IGNORE_SSL_ERRORS is read here from the environment, without its system property or superseded name (F-0197) | **Not checked**: Anything but true, in any case, means false | Not in production | Yes |
| `corsEnabled` (init-param) | `true` | Whether every federation endpoint sends CORS headers | **Not checked**: Anything but true, in any case, means false | Any | No |
| `corsAllowOrigin` (init-param) | `*` | Access-Control-Allow-Origin on the federation endpoints | **Not checked**: Sent as given | Any | No |
| `corsAllowMethods` (init-param) | `GET, OPTIONS` | Access-Control-Allow-Methods on the federation endpoints | **Not checked**: Sent as given | Any | No |
| `corsAllowHeaders` (init-param) | `Accept, Content-Type` | Access-Control-Allow-Headers on the federation endpoints | **Not checked**: Sent as given | Any | No |
| `corsMaxAge` (init-param) | `3600`; a whole number | Access-Control-Max-Age on the federation endpoints, in seconds | **Doesn't start**: Not a whole number: the federation servlet does not start | Any | No |
| `tokenEndpointAuthMethodsSupported` (init-param) | `private_key_jwt,attest_jwt_client_auth,attest_jwt_client_auth_dpop`; a list, space- or comma-separated | token_endpoint_auth_methods_supported in the openid_provider metadata | **Not checked**: Published as given | Any | No |
| `clientAttestationSigningAlgValuesSupported` (init-param) | `RS256,PS256,ES256`; a list, space- or comma-separated | client_attestation_signing_alg_values_supported in the openid_provider metadata | **Not checked**: Published as given | Any | No |
| `clientAttestationPopSigningAlgValuesSupported` (init-param) | `ES256,RS256,PS256`; a list, space- or comma-separated | client_attestation_pop_signing_alg_values_supported in the openid_provider metadata | **Not checked**: Published as given | Any | No |
| `dpopSigningAlgValuesSupported` (init-param) | `ES256,RS256,PS256`; a list, space- or comma-separated | dpop_signing_alg_values_supported in the openid_provider metadata | **Not checked**: Published as given | Any | No |
| `clientAttestationFormatsSupported` (init-param) | `jwt`; a list, space- or comma-separated | Read and kept, and never published | **Not checked**: Has no effect | Any | No |
| `clientAttestationPopMethodsSupported` (init-param) | `attestation_pop_jwt,dpop_combined`; a list, space- or comma-separated | The attestation proof-of-possession methods the openid_provider metadata advertises | **Not checked**: Published as given | Any | No |
| `attestationChallengeEndpointEnabled` (init-param) | `true` | Whether the openid_provider metadata advertises the attestation challenge endpoint | **Not checked**: Anything but true, in any case, means false | Any | No |
